containers.name: extract_customer_single_view_cleansed
containers.description: Output of the datalake-hbase-extractor-spark program: per-customer product-holding counts read from the shared customer-single-view HBase table (deposit_account, loan_account, and user_info qualifier families), pipe-separated with header. Lands under a daily YYYYMMDD subfolder, inside a product_holdings_tmp_output/ working folder. Same 9-column schema as the gold_safe product_holdings_info output below -- the source doc's Extractor and Differentiator pages both point their 'Output Schema' section at the identical schema page, so this is stated equivalence, not an assumption.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer CIF. Remark column in source schema: customer_id.

columns.name: count_savings_account
columns.description: Remark column in source schema: deposit_account|count_saving_account. Note: the extractor's own app.properties COLUMNS_MAPPING names this field count_saving_account (singular) -- the schema table and the config disagree on the exact field name; kept as the schema table states it, see draft notes.

columns.name: count_current_account
columns.description: Remark column in source schema: deposit_account|count_current_account.

columns.name: count_MyMo
columns.description: Remark column in source schema: user_info|count_MyMo. Note: the user_info qualifier family on the shared customer-single-view HBase table is not yet in that table's own catalog config (deliberately left out pending its own source pipeline) -- see draft notes.

containers.name: product_holdings_info_gold_safe
containers.description: Output of the datalake-customer-360-differentiator-spark program: delta (changed-only) rows versus the previous day's extract_customer_single_view file, pipe-separated without header. Same 9-column schema as extract_customer_single_view_cleansed above -- per the source doc's Execution Process, the differentiator internally adds a data_status (C/U/D) and daily_date column for its own compare logic, then explicitly drops the status column before the final write, so those two working columns are not part of the schema below.

columns.name: count_savings_account
columns.description: See extract_customer_single_view_cleansed for the same field-naming note.
